name: The Road
notes: The wanderer again, the same man blade for blade: this recipe differs from the_road.json in its sword layer and nothing else, which a test holds. He is drawn from this sheet while this sword is the one he wears, and the sword is in the swing alone, so he still walks the village unarmed. The rapier is the hermit's gift: a thin blade on the same 192px frames, reaching as far as the longsword.
